dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I can tell you've put a great deal of thought into decorating the study.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The potted plant in particular — it's refined and elegant in appearance, but still carries with it a subtle hint of the wilderness. For those who spend extended periods of time at their desk, it's no doubt a relaxing sight.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Taking care of the mind is an important part of healthy living. In that sense, the layout of your study is an ideal one.
